firm_data.firm_description: BERG & DAVID PLLC represents litigants in both State and Federal Courts and has an excellent reputation for handling high stake complex commercial litigation matters. The firm has successfully represented hundreds of homeowners, borrowers, investors, lienholders as well as lenders in residential and commercial foreclosure proceedings.
notable_facts: The firm defends homeowners, borrowers, investors, property owners and lien holders in foreclosure proceedings throughout New York City and Long Island.

They have successfully defended foreclosure actions by asserting a Statute of Limitations defense and ultimately bringing a Quiet Title action against the Foreclosing Bank resulting in the Mortgage being discharged from the subject property.

email.subject: AI for BERG & DAVID PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi David,

Your work defending homeowners and borrowers in foreclosure proceedings across New York City and Long Island requires precision under pressure, especially when facing institutional lenders with deep resources.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Inwood office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with larger competitors in complex commercial and foreclosure litigation.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
